name: Orbit Mail
summary:
Orbit Mail brings all your email to Meta Quest. It's free, has no ads and doesn't need an account of its own.

ANY EMAIL ACCOUNT
Add Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, Yahoo or the address on your own domain. Orbit Mail finds the server settings for you, and if it can't, you can enter the IMAP and SMTP details yourself. Add as many accounts as you need and see them together in one inbox or one by one.

MADE FOR YOUR HEADSET
A wide two-pane window shows your messages on the left and the one you're reading on the right.
